title.zh: Morning Minute: SEC Clears Token Buybacks for Crypto Networks
title.en: Morning Minute: SEC Clears Token Buybacks for Crypto Networks

current_state.zh: The SEC's Division of Corporation Finance updated its crypto FAQ to clarify that announcing a token buyback for a functional network does not represent 'essential managerial efforts' under the Howey test, alongside market items including a $2.39B BTC ETF inflow week and a Citi–Coinbase stablecoin partnership for institutions.
